app.name: Daybook
app.description: My day at a glance: clock, weather, calendar, notes and ideas.

clock.title: Tap to switch between 12-hour and 24-hour time

wx.title: Weather
wx.askWhere: Where are you? Use your location or search for a city.
wx.noGeo: This browser can't share your location. Search for your city instead.
wx.previewGeo: Location only works on your Daybook website. Search for your city, or open the website.
wx.geoDenied: Location permission is off. Allow location for this site in your browser settings, or search for your city below.
wx.geoFailed: Couldn't find your location just now. Try again, or search for your city below.
wx.noMatch: No places match “{q}”. Try the city name only.
wx.searchDown: City search isn't reachable right now. Check your connection.
wx.searchOnSite: City search works on your website:
wx.loadError: Couldn't load the weather. Check your internet connection, then try again.
wx.previewError: This preview can't reach the weather service. Live weather and your location work on your Daybook website.

cal.empty: Nothing planned yet. Add something below.
cal.planPh: Add a plan for this day

notes.title: Notes
notes.empty: No notes yet. Write your first one in the box above.

ideas.title: Ideas
ideas.bodyPh: Write anything. It saves as you type.
ideas.empty: No ideas yet. Press “New idea” to start writing.

sync.title: Move your data
sync.intro: Notes, plans and ideas are saved on each device. To bring them to your phone or laptop, copy them here and paste them there.
sync.footnote: Adding keeps everything already here and keeps the newest version of each note and idea. Deleting something on one device doesn't delete it on the other.
sync.copied: Copied. Paste it on your other device
sync.selectCopy: Select the code and copy it
sync.badCode: That code didn't work. Copy the whole code again, starting with DAYBOOK, and paste it here.
sync.pasteFirst: Paste the code from your other device first.
sync.fileFailed: Couldn't save the file. Use Copy my data instead.

common.storageFull: Couldn't save. Your browser storage is full or blocked.

examples.note1: Example note: click any note to edit it. Changes save by themselves.
examples.note2: Example: oat milk, call Mom, return the library books
